group: AnyOfValidator - node matches at least one subschema

cases.description: The AnyOfValidator should succeed when the instance node satisfies at least one of the subschemas defined in the "anyOf" keyword. The test uses a simple string schema as one of the alternatives, so validation must return an empty set.

group: AnyOfValidator - node matches multiple subschemas (short‑circuit true)

cases.description: When more than one subschema validates successfully, the validator may short‑circuit after the first successful match. This case verifies that no ValidationMessage is produced and that the internal short‑circuit flag is honoured.

group: AnyOfValidator - node matches none of the subschemas

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> containing a single message with type='anyOf' and message='instance does not match any schema in anyOf'
cases.description: The validator must return a ValidationMessage when the instance fails to satisfy any of the schemas listed under "anyOf".

group: AnyOfValidator - empty anyOf array

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> containing a message indicating that anyOf must contain at least one schema
cases.description: If the schema's anyOf array is empty, validation should fail immediately with a clear error message.

group: AnyOfValidator - null node (instance is missing)

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> containing a message that the instance is missing and cannot be validated against anyOf
cases.description: When the instance node is null, the validator should treat it as a validation failure unless the anyOf subschemas explicitly allow null.

group: AnyOfValidator - walk flag set to true (internal validation of subschemas)

cases.description: The protected overload validate(..., boolean walk) is exercised via a subclass that exposes it. When walk is true the validator must recursively walk each subschema; this test ensures that a matching subschema still results in no errors.

group: AnyOfValidator - canShortCircuit() returns false (full evaluation)

cases.description: When canShortCircuit() is overridden to return false, the validator must evaluate all subschemas even after a successful match. The test verifies that no ValidationMessage is produced and that the method does not exit early.

group: AnyOfValidator - preloadJsonSchema invoked before validation

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> and preloadJsonSchema called exactly once
cases.description: The validator should call preloadJsonSchema() the first time validation is performed to resolve any referenced schemas. The test asserts that the call occurs and that validation still succeeds.

group: AnyOfValidator - node null but anyOf allows null

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> (null instance matches the 'type":"null' subschema)
cases.description: When the instance node is null and the anyOf array contains a subschema that explicitly permits null, validation must succeed and return no errors.

group: AnyOfValidator - anyOf contains boolean true schema (always passes)

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> (anyOf includes a true schema which validates any instance)
cases.description: A boolean schema `true` inside anyOf should cause validation to succeed regardless of the other subschemas.

group: AnyOfValidator - anyOf contains boolean false schema (fails unless another subschema passes)

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> (second subschema matches, first is false)
cases.description: The anyOf array contains a `false` schema (which never matches) followed by a valid string schema. Validation must succeed because at least one subschema matches.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> containing a single anyOf error (no subschema matches)
cases.description: Both subschemas fail (first is false, second expects a string). The validator must return a single anyOf error, not two.

group: AnyOfValidator - anyOf contains empty schema {} (matches any node)

cases.description: An empty schema `{}` inside anyOf should validate any instance successfully.

group: AnyOfValidator - duplicate subschemas, ensure single success

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> (duplicate schemas both match, but validator returns no errors)
cases.description: anyOf may contain identical subschemas. Validation should succeed after the first match; duplicate entries must not cause extra errors.

group: AnyOfValidator - anyOf with const value matching

cases.description: A subschema with `"const":"fixed"` should cause validation to succeed when the instance equals that constant.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> with a single anyOf error (const does not match)
cases.description: When the const value does not match, and no other subschema matches, anyOf must produce one error.

group: AnyOfValidator - anyOf with enum matching

cases.description: A subschema with an `enum` that includes the instance value should cause validation to succeed.

group: AnyOfValidator - single error aggregation when all subschemas fail

cases.description: Even though multiple subschemas (e.g., string, boolean, object) fail, AnyOfValidator must return exactly one ValidationMessage describing the anyOf failure.

group: AnyOfValidator - short‑circuit disabled, all subschemas evaluated

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> and counter == 3 (all three subschemas validated)
cases.description: When canShortCircuit() returns false, the validator must evaluate every subschema even after a successful match. A mock subschema validator increments a shared counter; the test asserts the counter equals the number of subschemas.

group: AnyOfValidator - validation of a nested child node (non‑root location)

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> (anyOf validates the child node correctly)
cases.description: The validator receives an instanceLocation pointing to a nested property. It must correctly evaluate anyOf against the child node while preserving the proper path in any generated messages.

group: AnyOfValidator - null executionContext should throw NullPointerException

cases.description: The validator expects a non‑null ExecutionContext. Passing null must result in a NullPointerException before any schema processing occurs.

group: AnyOfValidator - null instanceLocation should throw NullPointerException

cases.description: A null JsonNodePath cannot be used to locate the instance node. The method should throw NullPointerException rather than silently ignoring the path.

group: AnyOfValidator - null rootNode should throw NullPointerException

cases.description: The validator uses the root document for $ref resolution and other checks. Supplying a null rootNode must cause a NullPointerException.

group: AnyOfValidator - malformed anyOf array element should throw IllegalArgumentException

cases.description: The anyOf keyword must contain schema objects (or boolean schemas). An integer literal is invalid and should cause the validator to throw IllegalArgumentException during schema parsing.

group: AnyOfValidator - anyOf contains $ref to non‑existent schema should throw JsonSchemaException

cases.description: When a subschema references a schema that cannot be resolved, the validator must raise a JsonSchemaException (or a subclass) indicating the unresolved reference.

group: AnyOfValidator - preloadJsonSchema throws IOException should propagate as JsonSchemaException

cases.description: If preloadJsonSchema attempts to load an external schema and encounters an IOException, the validator should wrap and re‑throw it as a JsonSchemaException.

group: AnyOfValidator - canShortCircuit throws RuntimeException (mis‑configuration) should propagate

cases.description: A subclass that overrides canShortCircuit() to throw a RuntimeException (simulating a bug) must let that exception propagate; the validator should not catch it silently.
